Experiment.title: Demo datasets used by the openECCI Python library

summary.motivation: Demo datasets used by the openECCI Python library for Electron Channelling Contrast Imaging (ECCI) analysis of crystal defects in scanning electron microscope (SEM). Data source: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.11169052 CC BY 4.0.
